# [STORY] As an operator, I want every ai-service entry point to authenticate its caller and treat interpolated text as data, so identity and prompt boundaries can't be asserted around

## User Story

**As an** operator of LMDB's AI features
**I want** every entry point into ai-service to authenticate its caller correctly and treat interpolated text as data, not instructions
**So that** identity, service-to-service, and prompt boundaries can't be crossed by a caller who simply asserts what they want to be true

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)

- [x] Given a request to a user-scoped ai-service endpoint, when it is processed, then the caller's identity comes only from the gateway-authenticated header, never from the request body (Task #193: `AiServiceIntegrationTest.chatIgnoresUserIdSuppliedInTheBody`)
- [x] Given a request with no `Authorization` header, when api-gateway forwards it, then no client-supplied identity header reaches any downstream service (Task #193: `JwtAuthenticationFilterTest.filter_shouldStripForgedIdentityHeadersWhenUnauthenticated`, `.filter_shouldStripForgedIdentityHeadersOnPublicPaths`)
- [x] Given a call to ai-service's gRPC surface, when it does not present the configured service token, then it is rejected before reaching any business logic (Task #193: `GrpcAuthInterceptorTest.missingTokenIsRejected`, `.unconfiguredInterceptorFailsClosed`)
- [x] Given text from a caller or from an upstream service, when it is interpolated into a model prompt, then it cannot forge additional conversation turns or role instructions (Task #193: `AiServiceIntegrationTest.chatMessageCannotForgeAdditionalTurns`, `.parseQuerySanitizesInputBeforeItReachesThePrompt`)
- [x] Given the offline speech-to-text model is fetched at image build time, when the fetched archive doesn't match the pinned checksum, then the build fails rather than unpacking it (Task #193: `backend/ai-service/Dockerfile`'s `sha256sum -c` step; the two checksums are still #229's placeholders, so the step fails on every build until that lands)

## Notes

Raised by a full file-by-file review of ai-service, the same review that produced #186. Task #194 fixed an unrelated gRPC classpath break found incidentally while verifying this Story's integration tests.
